mapper.select: WITH ranked_order AS ( SELECT CAST(om.room_id AS CHAR) AS roomId, CAST(om.order_id AS CHAR) AS orderId, om.status AS orderStatus, om.start_at AS checkInAt, om.end_at AS checkOutAt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY om.room_id ORDER BY CASE WHEN om.status = 'checked_in' THEN 1 WHEN om.status = 'booked' THEN 2 WHEN om.status = 'pending' THEN 3 WHEN om.status = 'refunding' THEN 4 ELSE 9 END ASC, om.start_at ASC, om.order_id ASC ) AS rowNum FROM order_main om WHERE om.camp_id = #{campId} AND om.is_deleted = 0 AND om.room_id IS NOT NULL AND om.status IN ('booked', 'checked_in', 'pending', 'refunding') AND om.start_at < #{nextDayStart} AND om.end_at > #{dayStart} ) SELECT CAST(r.room_id AS CHAR) AS roomId, r.clean_status AS cleanStatus, r.lock_status AS lockStatus, ro.orderId AS orderId, ro.orderStatus AS orderStatus, ro.checkInAt AS checkInAt, ro.checkOutAt AS checkOutAt FROM room r LEFT JOIN ranked_order ro ON ro.roomId = CAST(r.room_id AS CHAR) AND ro.rowNum = 1 WHERE r.camp_id = #{campId} AND r.status = 1 AND r.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY r.sort_no ASC, r.room_id ASC

SELECT CAST(om.order_id AS CHAR) AS orderId, om.status AS orderStatus, om.start_at AS startAt, om.end_at AS endAt, om.day_num AS dayNum, om.total_price_cent AS totalPriceCent, COALESCE(do.commission_price_cent, om.distribution_commission_cent, om.commission_price_cent, 0) AS commissionPriceCent, CASE WHEN om.settlement_amount_cent > 0 THEN om.settlement_amount_cent WHEN om.total_pay_price_cent > 0 THEN GREATEST( om.total_pay_price_cent - COALESCE(do.commission_price_cent, om.distribution_commission_cent, om.commission_price_cent, 0), 0 ) ELSE GREATEST( om.total_price_cent - COALESCE(do.commission_price_cent, om.distribution_commission_cent, om.commission_price_cent, 0), 0 ) END AS businessIncomeCent, COALESCE( NULLIF(ca.channel_name, ''), CASE WHEN om.source_type = 'frontdesk' THEN '自来客' WHEN om.source_type = 'phone' THEN '电话订单' ELSE '未知渠道' END ) AS channelName, om.guest_name AS guestName, om.guest_mobile AS guestMobile, rc.name AS roomCategoryName, r.room_name AS roomName, om.source_type AS sourceType FROM order_main om LEFT JOIN channel_account ca ON ca.account_id = om.channel_id AND ca.camp_id = om.camp_id LEFT JOIN distribution_order do ON do.source_order_id = om.order_id AND do.camp_id = om.camp_id AND (do.channel_id = om.channel_id OR do.channel_id IS NULL) LEFT JOIN room_category rc ON rc.room_category_id = om.room_category_id LEFT JOIN room r ON r.room_id = om.room_id WHERE om.camp_id = #{campId} AND om.is_deleted = 0 AND om.order_type = 'daily_room' AND om.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'refunded', 'pending') AND om.start_at < #{rangeEndExclusive} AND om.end_at > #{rangeStart} ORDER BY om.start_at ASC, om.order_id ASC

SELECT CAST(om.order_id AS CHAR) AS orderId, COALESCE( NULLIF(ca.channel_name, ''), CASE WHEN om.source_type = 'frontdesk' THEN '自来客' WHEN om.source_type = 'phone' THEN '电话订单' ELSE '未知渠道' END ) AS channelName, om.guest_name AS guestName, om.guest_mobile AS guestMobile, rc.name AS roomCategoryName, r.room_name AS roomName, om.status AS orderStatus, om.start_at AS startAt, om.end_at AS endAt, om.day_num AS dayNum, om.created_at AS createdAt FROM order_main om LEFT JOIN channel_account ca ON ca.account_id = om.channel_id AND ca.camp_id = om.camp_id LEFT JOIN room_category rc ON rc.room_category_id = om.room_category_id LEFT JOIN room r ON r.room_id = om.room_id WHERE om.camp_id = #{campId} AND om.is_deleted = 0 AND om.order_type = 'daily_room' AND om.status IN ('booked', 'checked_in', 'pending')
AND ( CAST(om.order_id AS CHAR) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR om.order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR om.out_order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR om.guest_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR om.guest_mobile LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR rc.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR r.room_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR ca.channel_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
ORDER BY om.start_at ASC, om.created_at ASC, om.order_id ASC
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM room r WHERE r.camp_id = #{campId} AND r.status = 1 AND r.is_deleted = 0
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(rc.room_count), 0) FROM room_category rc WHERE rc.camp_id = #{campId} AND rc.status = 1 AND rc.is_deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM order_main om WHERE om.camp_id = #{campId} AND om.is_deleted = 0 AND om.status IN ('refunding', 'cancelled', 'refunded')
